name: edgelab-portal-space
description: blog.edgelab.space — 1:1 React prototype (site/) prerendered to static, SEO-ready HTML (build/).

scripts.verify: node scripts/verify-google-seo.mjs && node scripts/verify-category-pages.mjs && node scripts/verify-related.mjs && node scripts/verify-readthrough-analytics.mjs

comments.prerender: scripts/prerender.mjs uses Playwright + system Chrome to render the client-side React prototype to static HTML. It relies on the GLOBAL Playwright install at /opt/homebrew/lib/node_modules/playwright (no local node_modules needed). If running elsewhere, install Playwright: `npm i -g playwright` (or `npm i -D playwright`) and ensure Google Chrome is present (channel:'chrome'). python3 must be on PATH (used to serve site/ over local HTTP during the render).
comments.output: build/ — deployable static files. site/ stays the canonical 1:1 design; do not edit it.
